types.name: MorphingModalApi
types.doc: What the body and the footer receive when they are written as functions.

members.name: close
members.doc: Closes the modal; it morphs back into the trigger.

types.name: MorphingModalProps
types.doc: A button that becomes the modal. The panel grows out of the trigger's own box (position, size, corner radius and color) and shrinks back into it on close, so there is never a question about where the modal came from. Focus is trapped while it is open, Escape and the scrim close it, and focus returns to the trigger.

members.name: trigger
members.doc: Content of the trigger button: a label, optionally with an icon.

members.name: title
members.doc: Title of the modal, also its accessible name.

members.name: children
members.doc: The body. Pass a function to receive `close`.

members.name: footer
members.doc: Actions pinned under the body. Pass a function to receive `close`.

members.name: onOpenChange
members.doc: Called with the next state when the trigger, Escape, the scrim or the close button is used.

members.name: variant
members.doc: Look of the trigger. The panel starts in the same color and settles into the surface color.

members.name: width
members.doc: Maximum width of the panel in px.

members.name: triggerClassName
members.doc: Extra class for the trigger button.
